steps.text: URI draft a letter to the warden regarding five students, sorry seven students, who left the hostel on Monday without permission. Make it formal.

blocks.text:
[Warden's Name]
[Hostel Name]
[Institution Name]
[City, State, Zip Code]
Subject: Unauthorized Departure of Students from Hostel
Respected Sir/Madam,

I am writing to bring to your immediate attention that seven students left the hostel on Monday without obtaining the necessary permission. This action is in violation of the hostel regulations regarding overnight stays and early departures.

I request you to look into this matter and take the appropriate disciplinary action as per the hostel rules. Please let me know if you require any further details regarding the identities of the students involved.
Yours faithfully,

[Your Name]
[Your Designation]
[Contact Information]

previous.summary: A formal letter to the hostel warden reporting that seven students left the hostel on Monday without permission.
previous.text:
The Warden,
[Hostel Name],
[Institution Name],
[City]

Subject: Unauthorized departure of students from the hostel

Respected Sir/Madam,

This is to bring to your kind notice that seven students left the hostel on Monday without obtaining prior permission. This action is in violation of the hostel regulations.

The names and roll numbers of the concerned students are listed below for your reference:

1. [Student Name 1] - [Roll Number]
2. [Student Name 2] - [Roll Number]
3. [Student Name 3] - [Roll Number]
4. [Student Name 4] - [Roll Number]
5. [Student Name 5] - [Roll Number]
6. [Student Name 6] - [Roll Number]
7. [Student Name 7] - [Roll Number]

I request you to take necessary action in this matter.

Yours faithfully,

[Your Name]
[Your Designation]
